limitations: Four original message captions and own-message clocks freshly read in logged-in Discord. No new video link, completed race total or media playback reviewed.
Every message in the 126-row filtered text queue now has a disposition. This certifies only disposition assignment for that saved filtered set, not correctness/completeness of all tour history.
Filter excludes abbreviated times, non-English clues, attachments and text without literal time/recording patterns. Review of unfiltered saved messages and live channel coverage remains necessary.
Previously reviewed recording claims, expired broadcast leads, Twitch relevance/playback, ambiguous opening times, deleted originals and anomalous result evidence remain unresolved.
Other channels, final standings, previous best chronology, fastest full-race recording coverage and live publication still require verification. No whole tour or year certified.
